Hi Natalie — great catch, and appreciate the agenda. Short answer: yes, this week is the exact DST crossover window between the US and EU (US moved earlier in March; EU switches on Sun Mar 30). That creates a one-hour offset change for a few days, which can cause confusion for participants in London vs those on US East/West.

Proposal: to avoid any mismatch, we can either
- keep the scheduled time but send the invite in UTC and call it out clearly in the invite text (we'll include UTC and local equivalents for US/EU/APAC), or
- move the session to Thursday 2025-04-03 or Tuesday 2025-04-01 so every region has stable offsets.

Concrete slots (all shown in UTC for clarity):
- Tue 2025-04-01 15:00 UTC (Tue 11am ET / 4pm BST)
- Wed 2025-04-02 14:00 UTC (Wed 10am ET / 3pm BST) — current placeholder
- Thu 2025-04-03 16:00 UTC (Thu 12pm ET / 5pm BST)

We also support an APAC-friendly slot if you need an Asia-Pacific attendee (we'd bring in our APAC SE). Please let us know which option you prefer and I'll update the invite and attach an availability snapshot.

Best,
Aditya Rao
